There is known French immigration within Aberdeenshire during the French Revolution, making it possible that this guitar traveled to Scotland with a French Family during this time.  Jacques-Pierre Michelot worked circa. 1760-1800 in Paris, France. He established his workshop at the sign ‘A la Mélodie’, rue St-Honoré. He was chiefly a guitar and lute maker but also made instruments of the violin family. The boat shaped body is typical of the maker and it is thought that the string conversion could have been carried out by the maker circa 1800. Another guitar by the maker, circa 1775, that was gifted to Marie- Antoinette by King Luis XVI sold at auction for €78,000 in 2022.
